latest_release.name: v0.9.0
latest_release.body:
## Highlights - **Flow: move between computers.** Pair two computers running OpenLogi and the pointer and keyboard follow you across the screen edge, with host switching handled for you. Set it up from the new Flow window: pairing, placing the other computer, per-device channels and removal (#1100, #1101, #1102, #1103, #1104, #2261, #2268). Idle Flow connections now stay alive instead of timing out.
1. Find the other computer 2. Confirm the code 3. Place it and choose devices
- **A reworked Actions Ring.** Aim by direction instead of hitting a slot exactly; hold the trigger and release to pick; choose a small, medium or large ring per device; slots now float translucently with tailed labels.
Directional aiming with tailed labels Small, medium and large
- **Magic Mouse–style momentum scrolling.** Optional per-device glide for a free-spinning smoothed wheel, with adjustable distance per notch, glide shape, max speed, length and repeat speed-up (#1994). - **New hardware.** Headset sidetone on the G535 (#2146) and support for the Spotlight receiver `046d:c53e` (#2157). - **Accessibility and GUI polish.** Visible focus rings, named icon buttons, Escape closes dialogs, Ctrl shortcuts outside macOS, and better contrast throughout. - **Platform fixes.** - Linux: debounced mouse buttons and wheel (#2243, #2247). - Windows: wheel direction (#2292), vendor report routing (#2283), tray icon (#2297). - macOS: agent watchdog (#2302), camera reset (#2314). - Everywhere: input injection fixes (#2300, #2301) and Unifying offline slot names (#2310). ## Upgrade notes - The config schema moves to v11 to add the `[flow]` section. Once 0.9.0 saves your config, older OpenLogi builds will refuse to load it. - Flow needs OpenLogi 0.9.0 on both computers. Thanks to Ruchit M, Pawel, whurst121280, semmelrinde, minovap, corvus2606, Mark, Kaspar Janowsky and ClemMcFly for contributing to this release. ## What's Changed * fix(agent): run pointer-mode shortcuts the focused app binds the same way by @AprilNEA in https://github.com/AprilNEA/OpenLogi/pull/2216 * feat: add per-device momentum scrolling by @minovap in https://github.com/AprilNEA/OpenLogi/pull/1994 * fix(cli): name logitech devices that expose no hid++ interface by @AprilNEA in https://github.com/AprilNEA/OpenLogi/pull/2220 * feat(hid): recognise the Spotlight presenter's USB receiver by @markhhm in https://github.com/AprilNEA/OpenLogi/pull/2157 * fix(device): restore the mapping read before host mode by @ClemMcFly in https://github.com/AprilNEA/OpenLogi/pull/2222 * fix(macos): flag a shortcut's arrow key with fn as a keyboard does by @AprilNEA in https://github.com/AprilNEA/OpenLogi/pull/2218 * fix(cli): say disabled

detail.readme:
> [!WARNING] > **OpenLogi is under active development** and not yet stable — features and config may still change. Give the repo a **Star** ⭐ and **Watch** 👀 it to get notified when a new release lands.

OpenLogi

⚡️ A native, local-first alternative to Logitech Options+, written in Rust 🦀
Unlock the full capabilities of Logitech mice, keyboards, and webcams over HID++ and UVC

> **Fed up with Options+? Try OpenLogi.** Runs on macOS, Linux, and Windows. --- ## Beyond Options+ Things OpenLogi does that Options+ won't: - **Stay light.** Native Rust + GPUI. - **Run on Linux.** Linux is a first-class platform in OpenLogi. - **Gestures on supported buttons.** Assign gesture actions to supported controls — or turn gestures off entirely. - **Plain-text config.** Everything is one TOML file you can sync between machines however you like. - **Script it.** A real CLI alongside the GUI: a JSON [automation API](docs/USAGE.md#automation-api) for DPI, SmartShift, Fn-lock, and report rate, plus hardware diagnostics. ## Features

### Devices - Logi Bolt and Unifying receivers, Bluetooth, and wired connections, with battery level and charge state - Low-battery notices at the bottom of the screen, once per discharge, with no OS notification permission - An on-screen indicator when a keyboard turns Caps Lock on or off, plus Num Lock and Scroll Lock on Windows and Linux - On macOS, a menu-bar menu that lists each device with its battery or light state, flags a missing permission, and changes the settings you reach for most without opening the app: DPI preset, wheel mode, Fn lock, backlight, disabled keys, headset sidetone, and a light's power, brightness, and color temperature. Hold ⌥ to see how each device connects
Easy-Switch
  • See which computer is paired on each channel, with its OS and connection
  • Rename a channel on devices that allow it
  • Bind a button or Actions Ring slot to move the device to another channel
### Buttons and actions
Remap any button
  • A built-in action catalog, custom shortcuts, typed text, or multi-step workflows
  • Separate tap and hold actions, and hold-to-talk chords that release with the button
  • Gestures on Middle Click, Back/Forward, DPI/ModeShift, the gesture button, and the haptic panel
Actions Ring
  • Eight actions in a ring around the cursor
  • Its own layout per application
Keyboard keys
  • Bind media, emoji, screenshot, and other dedicated keys like mouse buttons
  • Restore one key to its device default, or reset the whole row
Per-application profiles switch with the focused app. An `[apps]` alias lets one profile follow an application across platforms. ### Pointer and scrolling
Pointer
  • DPI presets with cycle and set-preset actions
  • Pointer speed and report rate
  • Precision Mode: one button switches the mouse to its slowest speed and back
SmartShift
  • Wheel mode and sensitivity
  • Scrolling force on SmartShift Enhanced mice
  • A permanent-ratchet switch

Scrolling
  • Scroll inversion per device, natively or in software
  • Wheel resolution and smooth wheel scrolling
  • Hold Back or Forward and roll the wheel to scroll sideways on mice without a thumb wheel
### Keyboard and lighting
Keyboard
  • Fn Lock, and multi-platform keyboards that stay on the host OS layout
  • Backlight level, automatic brightness, battery saving, and how long the keys stay lit
  • The backlight level shown on screen as it changes
  • Static RGB on supported keyboards
Litra lights
  • Power, brightness, and color temperature
  • Turns on with the camera if you want
  • Keeps a change made on the light itself
### Webcams - Any Logitech UVC webcam (Brio, StreamCam, the C920 series, …), plug and play - Live preview that holds the camera only while you watch; leave it and the LED goes off - Pick the preview's resolution and frame rate from the modes your camera reports (this shapes OpenLogi's own preview, not what other apps get) - On macOS and Windows, a camera on a slower USB link than it supports (a USB 2 port, hub, or cable) is flagged, since it lists fewer resolutions and frame rates than it can deliver on USB 3 - Zoom, pan, tilt, focus, exposure, white balance, and every other UVC control, written to the hardware so Meet, Zoom, and OBS see the change - Built-in Default / Streaming / Video call profiles plus your own snapshots, kept per camera Feature coverage depends on what each device reports; the app shows only the controls a device supports. ### Platform support | Feature | macOS | Windows | Linux | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | Mouse button remapping and gestures | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | | Keyboard F-key remapping | ✓ | ✓ | — | | Per-application profiles | ✓ | ✓ | X11, wlroots (sway, Hyprland), GNOME with the [companion extension](crates/openlogi-hook/gnome-shell-extension/README.md) | | Mouse profile follows the window under the pointer | ✓ | ✓ | X11 only | | Media keys | Native | Native | D-Bus MPRIS | | Window-manager actions (desktops, Mission Control, …) | Native | Native equivalents | GNOME, KDE (KWin), Hyprland; some macOS-only actions do nothing | | Menu-bar / tray icon | ✓ | ✓ | — | | Device controls in the menu-bar / tray menu | ✓ | — | — | | In-app updates | Sparkle | Built-in | Built-in | ## Install > [!IMPORTANT] > Quit **Logi Options+** (and Solaar on Linux) first. Only one application can own a receiver at a time. > On macOS, **Karabiner-Elements** also locks a Bluetooth keyboard that it modifies. Turn off **Modify events** for that keyboard in Karabiner-Elements → Settings → Devices. | Platform | System | Architecture | | --- | --- | --- | | macOS | macOS 13 or later | Apple silicon, Intel | | Linux | GLIBC 2.35 or newer | x86_64, arm64 | | Windows | Tested on Windows 11 | x86_64, arm64 | Every download carries a minisign signature and an entry in `SHA256SUMS`. To build from source, see [DEVELOPMENT.md](docs/DEVELOPMENT.md). ### macOS

 

Or with Homebrew: ```sh brew install --cask openlogi ``` Open OpenLogi and grant **Accessibility** and **Input Monitoring** when macOS asks. OpenLogi then updates itself through Sparkle. ### Linux

   

Or install the right package for your distribution with one command. It verifies the minisign signature and starts the agent; install `minisign` first: ```sh curl -fsSL https://github.com/AprilNEA/OpenLogi/releases/latest/download/install.sh | sh ``` On Arch Linux, the [`openlogi`](https://aur.archlinux.org/packages/openlogi) AUR package builds the release from source: ```sh yay -S openlogi ``` To read the script before running it, and for the AUR package, Flatpak, NixOS, and distributions without systemd, see [INSTALL-linux.md](docs/INSTALL-linux.md). ### Windows

 

## Usage (CLI) See [USAGE.md](docs/USAGE.md) ## Configuration Settings use plain TOML; saves preserve symlinked config files. See [CONFIGURATION.md](docs/CONFIGURATION.md). ## Developing See [DEVELOPMENT.md](docs/DEVELOPMENT.md), including [macOS input-hook safety](docs/DEVELOPMENT.md#macos-input-hook-safety). ## Acknowledgments ### Contributors Logo and app icon by [@kubai087](https://github.com/kubai087). ### Credits - [Solaar](https://github.com/pwr-Solaar/Solaar) for documenting Logitech's HID++ protocol and device behavior in the open. - [Mouser](https://github.com/TomBadash/Mouser) by [@TomBadash](https://github.com/TomBadash) for inspiring a local, account-free take on Options+. ### Infrastructure ## License The code in this repository is dual-licensed under either of - Apache License, Version 2.0 ([LICENSE-APACHE](LICENSE-APACHE)) - MIT license ([LICENSE-MIT](LICENSE-MIT)) at your option. ### Logo & brand assets The OpenLogi logo and app icon (the brand assets under [`design/`](design/)) are © 2026 AprilNEA, all rights reserved, and are not covered by the MIT/Apache licenses above; see [`design/LICENSE`](design/LICENSE).
